title: The development of weather science（机经听写）
titleCn: 天气科学的发展史（气象学之父）

paragraphs.text: The development of weather science. Many people thought that the planets were responsible for causing bad weather. For example, if a lot of ants were around, rain was coming, while a wind from the east could lead to a headache.Talking about the development of weather science. In the US, Benjamin Franklin suggested that a boat could be pulled over by a kite with the right winds. A chemist from England called Luke Howard identified and named different kinds of clouds. James Glaisher traveled by balloon to measure temperature and humidity. The most challenging weather phenomenon to comprehend was a storm.In 1854, a politician proposed using electric telegraph to transmit weather information across Britain.Moving on to the father of British meteorology, his name is Robert Fitzroy. He set up 15 weather stations along Britain's coast and gathered data from them. He produced the first forecast on a regular basis. His innovation saved lives, but his impact on some workers income.
